runifold-agent.owns: Canonical model/callable loop, review, structured completion and sessions

runifold.owns: Public re-exports, ProviderRuntime and ergonomic composition
runifold.does_not_own: Transport wire formats and a second execution loop

runifold-core.owns: Run identity, authority, budgets, cancellation, events and checkpoints
runifold-core.does_not_own: Provider, protocol, storage backend and application policy implementations

runifold-effect.owns: Write-ahead effects, stable replay identity and explicit recovery
runifold-effect.does_not_own: Vendor-specific business handlers and guaranteed remote exactly-once delivery

runifold-eval-cli.owns: Evaluation CLI and CI regression gates

runifold-model.owns: Provider-neutral content, model invocation, streams, routing and retry contracts
runifold-model.does_not_own: Vendor wire types and Agent tool loops

runifold-mcp.owns: MCP client/server protocol and runtime adapters
runifold-mcp.does_not_own: Changes to core authority or model IR for MCP wire formats

runifold-observability-otel.owns: Optional OpenTelemetry projection of canonical observations
runifold-observability-otel.does_not_own: Core event semantics or default prompt capture

runifold-ops.owns: Read-only execution inspection, evidence and value-free diffs
runifold-ops.does_not_own: Executing replayed model calls or external writes

runifold-cli.owns: Operational commands and AI development context/diagnostics
runifold-cli.does_not_own: Runtime implementation or executing suggested repairs

runifold-providers.owns: Feature-gated vendor transports and canonical protocol projection
runifold-providers.does_not_own: Kernel semantics and hidden Agent loops

runifold-provider-testkit.owns: Loopback protocol cassettes, conformance and benchmark contracts

runifold-retrieval.owns: Provider-neutral retrieval, documents and semantic-memory contracts
runifold-retrieval.does_not_own: A mandatory vector database or opinionated RAG application

runifold-retrieval-text.does_not_own: Model execution and remote vector stores

runifold-store-postgres.owns: PostgreSQL implementations of durable runtime stores

runifold-store-sqlite.owns: SQLite implementations of durable runtime stores
runifold-store-sqlite.does_not_own: A separate execution model or implicit unsafe recovery

runifold-testkit.owns: Deterministic models, fault injection and offline evaluation

runifold-tool.owns: Typed tool descriptors, registry, input validation and safe errors

runifold-workflow.owns: Deterministic composition, durable steps, workers, leases, timers and signals

laws.title: Visible output and effects constrain retry safety
History, journal and memory remain distinct

create-agent.title: Create an Agent
requirements: OPENAI_API_KEY only when running, not compiling
create-agent.runtime_path: ProviderRuntime → AgentBuilder → Agent → canonical execute_state → model/callables → validated outcome

add-tool.title: Add a typed Tool
requirements: Production example: runifold-providers with openai, tokio, anyhow; OPENAI_API_KEY only when running
add-tool.runtime_path: Agent callable preflight → EffectExecutor → ToolRegistry::invoke → Tool::invoke → output validation → canonical transcript

structured-output.title: Return typed structured output
requirements: runifold-testkit and futures-executor for the offline test
Production example: runifold-providers with openai, tokio, anyhow; OPENAI_API_KEY only when running
structured-output.runtime_path: Canonical Agent loop → candidate → local completion validation / bounded repair → typed outcome

stream-agent.title: Stream an Agent
requirements: runifold-testkit and futures-executor for the offline test
Production example: runifold-providers with openai, tokio, anyhow; OPENAI_API_KEY only when running
stream-agent.runtime_path: Agent::stream → canonical Agent engine → buffered observer → model/callable/usage events → Completed or Err

durable-conversation.title: Persist a conversation and replay a request
durable-conversation.runtime_path: AgentSession admission → stable request/checkpoint identity → canonical Agent/effects → conversation commit → request replay

add-provider.title: Add a Provider adapter
requirements: Use the new feature in place of anthropic in validation once implemented
add-provider.runtime_path: ModelRequest → adapter wire projection → transport → canonical stream accumulator → ModelResponse

add-reviewer.title: Review an Agent answer before completion
requirements: runifold-testkit and futures-executor for the offline test
Production example: runifold-providers with openai, tokio, anyhow; OPENAI_API_KEY only when running
add-reviewer.runtime_path: Candidate → local terminal validation → attenuated reviewer → approve / bounded repair / reject → completion commit

add-effect.title: Add recoverable external work
add-effect.api: Tool effect descriptor; EffectExecutor for low-level effect orchestration
requirements: runifold with runtime; sqlite-bundled for durable publication
Low-level example uses runifold-effect test helpers
add-effect.runtime_path: Capability preflight → stable effect identity → persisted Started → handler / reconciliation → persisted Completed → replay

add-workflow-step.title: Compose workflow steps
requirements: OPENAI_API_KEY only to run the assembly example
add-workflow-step.runtime_path: Workflow definition → durable worker / step execution → explicit child authority → canonical Agent → persisted step progress

test-provider.title: Test a Provider offline
requirements: Local loopback sockets; no vendor credentials
test-provider.runtime_path: CassetteServer expected request → real loopback transport → adapter → canonical success/error conformance checks

conversation.title: Use conversation history
requirements: runifold-testkit and futures-executor for the offline source test
conversation.runtime_path: Load conversation → bounded context selection → canonical Agent run → optimistic atomic transcript append

add-retriever.title: Add retrieval context
requirements: runifold-testkit and futures-executor for the offline source test
Production example: runifold-providers with openai, tokio, anyhow; OPENAI_API_KEY only when running
add-retriever.runtime_path: Agent context preparation → retrieval capability check → Retriever::retrieve → untrusted user context → model invocation

modify-agent-loop.title: Modify the canonical Agent loop
requirements: runifold-testkit and futures-executor for the offline source test
modify-agent-loop.runtime_path: Initial state → canonical execute_state → model → turn review → callable effects → completion / terminal review

public-api-change.title: Change a public API
public-api-change.api: Owning crate export → facade export → executable contract
requirements: runifold-testkit and futures-executor for the offline source test
public-api-change.runtime_path: Public caller → owning crate API → existing canonical implementation; facade re-exports preserve that path

diagnostics.title: NotFound
causes: The NotFound boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Register the named Tool on the Agent builder or ToolRegistry; check the model-facing name.

diagnostics.title: InvalidInput
causes: The InvalidInput boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Validate arguments against the Tool input schema and fix the caller.

diagnostics.title: CapabilityDenied
causes: The CapabilityDenied boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Register the Tool and explicitly grant its capability to the current RunContext or child grant.

diagnostics.title: Cancelled
causes: The Cancelled boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Honor cancellation; start new work only when the caller requests it.

diagnostics.title: DeadlineExceeded
causes: The DeadlineExceeded boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Inspect deadline and retry safety before starting another invocation.

diagnostics.title: Execution
causes: The Execution boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Inspect the safe typed application cause; do not blindly retry a write.

diagnostics.title: InvalidOutput
causes: The InvalidOutput boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Return the declared output shape and preserve rich content through ToolOutput.

diagnostics.title: CapabilityDenied
causes: The CapabilityDenied boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Grant only the effect capability intended for this Run.

diagnostics.title: IdempotencyConflict
causes: The IdempotencyConflict boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Reuse an idempotency key only for identical logical work; inspect persisted input and identity.

diagnostics.title: Ambiguous
causes: The Ambiguous boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Reconcile the external receipt; retry only under an explicit recovery policy with evidence of safety.

diagnostics.title: Store
causes: The Store boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Restore durable store availability and inspect the last persisted effect state before recovery.

diagnostics.title: Observability
causes: The Observability boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Restore journal availability; preserve fail-closed execution.

diagnostics.title: Handler
causes: The Handler boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Inspect the typed handler cause and retry safety before deciding to repeat work.

diagnostics.title: Cancelled
causes: The Cancelled boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Honor cancellation and preserve any ambiguous external effect record.

diagnostics.title: DeadlineExceeded
causes: The DeadlineExceeded boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Inspect external outcome and deadline before recovery.

diagnostics.title: Protocol
causes: The Protocol boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Inspect persisted effect state/version; do not overwrite evidence to force progress.

diagnostics.title: Reconciliation
causes: The Reconciliation boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Restore receipt lookup and reconcile again without repeating the external write.

diagnostics.title: InvalidRequest
causes: The InvalidRequest boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Correct the canonical request according to the selected API and schema.

diagnostics.title: UnsupportedFeature
causes: The UnsupportedFeature boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Select a model with verified support or explicitly choose visible degradation; never guess support.

diagnostics.title: Transport
causes: The Transport boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Inspect endpoint and retry safety; account for visible output and external work before retrying.

diagnostics.title: Protocol
causes: The Protocol boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Inspect a redacted wire cassette and adapter version; fix projection without losing semantics.

diagnostics.title: StreamState
causes: The StreamState boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Require a valid started/content/terminal lifecycle; do not fabricate successful completion.

diagnostics.title: MalformedToolArguments
causes: The MalformedToolArguments boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Validate complete JSON arguments; do not execute partially parsed input.

diagnostics.title: Provider
causes: The Provider boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Inspect the safe provider category and rate-limit metadata before applying explicit retry policy.

diagnostics.title: Cancelled
causes: The Cancelled boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Honor caller cancellation.

diagnostics.title: DeadlineExceeded
causes: The DeadlineExceeded boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Inspect upstream latency and remaining deadline before any retry.

diagnostics.title: capability_denied

diagnostics.title: budget_exceeded

diagnostics.title: deadline_exceeded

diagnostics.canonical_fix: Inspect the effective deadline and external outcome.

diagnostics.title: cancelled
causes: Inspect the existing RunError kind, safe message and retry safety.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Honor caller cancellation.

diagnostics.title: transport
causes: Inspect the existing RunError kind, safe message and retry safety.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Inspect retry safety before retrying.

diagnostics.title: protocol
causes: Inspect the existing RunError kind, safe message and retry safety.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Inspect the canonical protocol boundary.

diagnostics.title: invocation

causes: Inspect the reported source evidence; this diagnostic does not authorize a retry or permission increase.

causes: Inspect the reported source evidence; this diagnostic does not authorize a retry or permission increase.

diagnostics.title: Validation planning failed
diagnostics.meaning: The selected source workspace or Git base could not be inspected.
causes: The working directory is not a Runifold source workspace, the base does not resolve, or required tooling is unavailable.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Select --root and --base explicitly; install Git and Python 3.11+.

diagnostics.title: Unknown task
diagnostics.meaning: The requested recipe is not in this knowledge version.
causes: Task ID spelling or knowledge version differs.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Run runifold ai context and choose a listed task.

diagnostics.title: Unknown diagnostic
diagnostics.meaning: The requested code is absent from this knowledge version.
causes: The code is misspelled or belongs to a different release or extension.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Use documentation for the producing library version; do not guess a repair from an unrelated code.
